interface.name: xwayland_satellite_overlay_v1
interface.description: Restricted to the compositor's X11 bridge. Mark an unmapped toplevel as an output-space overlay. The compositor owns placement and focus policy. Application identity is unchanged. No privilege over a session lock is granted.

arg.name: output_name
arg.summary: wl_output name, empty for compositor default
